page.overview:
Who is Aerowynn?

Aerowynn was a male Drall who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. During the Empire's invasion on Corellia, Aerowynn and many of the Drall aided the Corellians to liberate Corellia. When he encountered Lieutenant Veet and his squad, he resisted initial attempts to allow them by taking his weapons factory until he was executed.
